# Project Smoke Detector — Builder-visible package

This directory is the published proposal package for the PSD proving project.
Only files beneath `builder_corpus/` are intended for Builder-side ingestion.
The private evaluation record is outside this directory and is never uploaded
or registered as a Source.

The package is deliberately mixed: most requirements are ordinary issued
procurement information, while a small number of realistic reconciliation,
closure, and pricing questions remain discoverable through cross-document
review.
